title: Drupal 9 read-only at 16:08: a /tmp inode war story
lede: A Drupal 9 site went quietly read-only on a Tuesday afternoon. The disk was 39 percent full. /tmp had bytes to spare. Every single inode, though, was gone.
hero_alt: Overhead photo of aged inode report 'df -i /tmp' with circled 16:08, Drupal printout, manila tab, brass INODES plate, ruler, pencil, wax seal.
